backend/main.mo: Defines backend actor with access control, story submission, user profiles, comments, reviews, and related state management.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report placeholder containing an empty features list.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file listing summaries of various frontend components and modules.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining canister roles, usage requirements, and basic deployment workflow.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining color tokens, theme variables, and global styling for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads the React app with the title 'Genuine-Being Real'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with routes for all app pages wrapped in a shared layout.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedStat: UI component showing an access denied message with a button returning users to the stories page.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header component rendering the site title and navigation buttons for Home and About.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Page layout with header, content area, and footer including contact info and navigation links.
Form component allowing users to submit a comment with name and text fields via mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/CommentThread.ts: Displays story comments with timestamps, loading skeletons, and an empty state when no comments exist.
frontend/src/components/CommentThreadDis: Displays comments for a story, handles loading state, empty state, and timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/components/FeedDiagnosticsP: Shows canister IDs and URLs with copy and open actions for troubleshooting.
frontend/src/components/ReviewComposer.t: Form component allowing users to submit ratings and optional comments for a story.
frontend/src/components/ReviewThread.tsx: Displays a list of reviews for a story with ratings, timestamps, and loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, auto-reinitializing on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides admin hooks for fetching all stories and publishing reworded stories with mutation invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAvailabilit: Checks backend heartbeat availability on demand and exposes reachability state.
frontend/src/hooks/useDiscussions.ts: Fetches discussions and provides a mutation for adding reviews with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useStories.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating stories and comments, including retry logic and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark pastel-blue theme tokens and global styling rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClient and Internet Identity providers and renders App.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Static About page showing author info, platform purpose, and contact details.
frontend/src/pages/AdminModerationPage.t: Admin interface for reviewing, editing, and publishing submitted stories with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Displays discussion topics with tabs for comments or reviews, including topic selection and thread rendering.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Fetches and displays published stories with retry-aware error states, backend availability checks, and diagnostics.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section and feature cards linking to reading and submitting stories.
frontend/src/pages/StoryDetailPage.tsx: Fetches and displays a full story with metadata and supports commenting via composer and thread components.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitStoryPage.tsx: Form for submitting a new story with optional anonymity, handling validation and post‑submit confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/TroubleshootingPage.t: Troubleshooting view explaining unresolved canister IDs and showing detected frontend/backend canister info.
frontend/src/utils/canisterUrls.ts: Utilities to detect frontend and backend canister IDs and generate standard and raw access URLs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash‑based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, animations, and plugin integrations. Extends theme with container setup, color palette, shadows, and accordion animations.
project_state.json: Project state describing a request to change the app’s color scheme from pink to pastel blue. Contains metadata, known issues, and a pending feature request.
